title: Fix ACP agent chat history, model updates, and installed-agent detection
description:
The Agent Chat panel currently fails to display the full history of thoughts, responses, and iterations with ACP coding agents. Root-cause analysis shows several wiring bugs:

1. ACP session events are emitted with the agent's sessionId but the AcpChatRunner subscribes using the host sessionKey, so agent_message_chunk, agent_thought_chunk, plan, tool_call, tool_call_update, and session-models-changed events never reach the runner or the UI.
2. turn-finished is never emitted from AcpClient, so the runner relies on a hardcoded end_turn stopReason.
3. Agent-reported model lists are discarded when currentModelId is missing or the event is lost.
4. KnownAgentDetector does not expand PATH with common package-manager bin directories, so locally installed agents (bun, cargo, homebrew, uv) are reported as missing.
5. The webview change-model/thinking/role messages are not handled by AgentChatViewProvider or AgentChatPanel, so user selections are ignored.

Acceptance criteria:
- ACP chat events are correctly routed to the runner using the host sessionKey.
- turn-finished is emitted with the real stopReason from the prompt response.
- Model updates from the agent are propagated to the webview model chip.
- Installed ACP agents in non-standard bin directories are detected correctly.
- Webview model/thinking/role selections are handled end-to-end.
- npm run check passes.
acceptance_criteria: ACP chat events reach the UI; model updates propagate; installed agents detected; webview selections handled; npm run check passes.

title: ACP Registry: detectar, instalar e atualizar agentes de codificação
description: As opções de instalação dos agentes de codificação do ACP Registry não aparecem corretamente na UI. Os agentes de codificação não estão sendo exibidos corretamente, nem as versões instaladas estão sendo detectadas. Precisamos detectar corretamente os agentes, instalar e atualizar quando necessário, e interagir com as funções do padrão ACP para tirar ao máximo os recursos de cada agente.

title: Apply workflow foundations to orchestration and cloud agents
description: Adopt the new shared workflow design-system foundations in the orchestration prototype and one adjacent surface so status semantics, section grouping, and empty states are proven beyond the foundation layer. This exists because the new primitives now need to replace one-off styling in a real workflow surface.

title: Apply workflow foundations to orchestration and hooks
description: Track the Phase 02 integration pass that refactors the orchestration prototype and hooks surface to consume the shared workflow design-system foundations, validates behavior with tests/checks, and lands the playbook update.

title: Design system foundations for orchestration workflows
description: Create the first shared design-system foundations for orchestration-heavy workflows by extracting VS Code token-backed spacing, density, panel grouping, status badge, empty state, metric row, and action toolbar primitives for the webview UI. This exists so orchestration and adjacent surfaces can share consistent status semantics and section layout without introducing a parallel styling system.

title: Validate orchestration read model task
description: Verify the first open Maestro playbook task for the unified orchestration read model, make any minimal fixes needed, update the playbook checkbox, and land the result.

title: Phase 01 orchestration prototype
description: Implement the phase 01 running-agents orchestration prototype by reusing existing running-agent, agent-chat, and cloud-agent surfaces. Deliver a unified read model, extension/webview prototype, reactive updates, architecture notes, and tests, then run the required quality gates.
